author: T3.2 (sonnet)
description: Scoring criteria for treasure-detector v1.0. 8 active criteria + 7 reserved for future releases. Each criterion maps to a real data source or is explicitly marked as awaiting T3.1.

grid.notes: H3 resolution 10 ≈ 65m hexagon side. [À VÉRIFIER] local calibration against cadastral parcel size.

criteria.label: Noyau villageois d'Armous — église XI siècle
criteria.justification: Medieval village nucleus XI–XIX centuries with church stones reused in 1840s. Two village cores in 9 km² → dense layer of metal in topsoil. Never excavated systematically. [FAIT] HISTOIRE §2.2, CIBLES §2.1.
criteria.evidence: cadastre napoléonien section C1/C2, Cassini, état-major, spike OSM

criteria.label: Noyau villageois de Cau — église médiévale
criteria.justification: [À VÉRIFIER] No cadastral section « de Cau » found in Armous-et-Cau (CIBLES §2.2). Coordinates from spike (43.57179 / 0.18647) unconfirmed. ACTIVATE ONLY IF T3.1 CONFIRMS CADASTRAL LOCATION.
criteria.evidence: spike OSM, archevêché d'Auch (XII s.), CIBLES.md unresolved
criteria.critical_condition: If cadastral location not confirmed before T3.3 merge, remove this criterion and flag Cau as exploratory target in CIBLES.md.

criteria.label: Tuileries gallo-romaines — Le Téoulé + La Tuilerie
criteria.justification: Two toponymies « teulèr » (tegulae = roof tiles). Gallo-Roman kiln marker. Surface mobilier: broken tegulae, calcaire broyé (lime), Roman coins. Often co-located with villa. [FAIT] lexique PLAN §2.5bis, [À VÉRIFIER] precise location.
criteria.evidence: toponymy gascon stable, IGN map reading, pottery surface finds (T2.3, T2.4)

criteria.label: Zone source du Midour — Hountan
criteria.justification: [FAIT] Source of Midour confirmed (SIA Midour-Douze, PLAN §2.1). Springs are natural habitat foci and Gallo-Roman cult sites (ex voto deposits). Mobilier: votive fibulae, Roman denarii, sanctuary ceramics. Ethymology 'hont'=spring (Gascon). PLAN §2.1, CIBLES §2.5.
criteria.evidence: SIA Midour-Douze registry, IGN toponymy, Nominatim/OSM

criteria.label: Via antique empierrée — Caussade
criteria.justification: Roman road (*calciata* = paved way). Ethmology confirmed Latin *calx* (stone/chalk). Stable Gascon toponymy across Cassini/état-major. Mobilier: lost coins (bronze low-empire, denarii), harness fittings, lead net weights, nails. PLAN §2.5bis, CIBLES §2.4.
criteria.evidence: BAN address « Impasse de Caussade », etymological dictionary, Cassini/état-major cartography

criteria.label: Microtoponyme rang 1 — sites de premier ordre

source.notes: Excludes already-scored criteria A1–C1 to avoid double-counting.

criteria.justification: Rank 1 microtoponymes (lexicon PLAN §2.5): glèisa (church), mothe (motte), castèra (fortification), priou (priory), Saint-* (oratories). Strong signals of medieval sites. Mobilier varies (coins, plumb, ferronnerie, cerámica). Not absolute certainty → lower weight than habitat-certain (A-rank).
criteria.evidence: Gascon toponymy lexicon (Polge 1965), cadastral atlas, spike OSM

criteria.label: Microtoponyme rang 2 — indices de position
criteria.justification: Rank 2 includes potential Gallo-Roman domain suffixes (-an = *-anum*, Polge 1965) and métairies (borde). Less established than rank 1 — many are patronymes (PLAN §2.5bis Polge caveat). Lower weight (12 vs 20) reflects uncertainty.
criteria.evidence: Gascon toponymy lexicon, cadastre napoléonien forms, Polge etymologies

criteria.label: Proximité à un cours d'eau — géographie de villa et gués

source.blocker: [MACHINE LOCALE] — proxy egress bloque data.geopf.fr depuis un conteneur d'agent (reconfirmé 2026-08-11). À exécuter par Oscar, puis repasser ce status à "disponible" une fois hydro_streams.geojson vérifié non vide.
source.engine_note: src/scoring/engine.ts sait désormais mesurer une distance point-segment sur LineString/MultiLineString (fix 2026-08-11, testé). Reste à faire au moment d'activer ce critère : le moteur (scoreZone) ne charge aujourd'hui qu'UN SEUL GeoJSON passé par l'appelant (data/derived/toponymes.geojson, cf. MapView.tsx) — il faudra le faire charger aussi hydro_streams.geojson par source.path avant que ce critère produise un résultat.

rule.notes: Villas prefer water (drinking, mills, fords). Additive criterion (stacks with others). kind=corridor : un cours d'eau est une ligne, pas un point — distance mesurée au segment le plus proche, pas au sommet le plus proche.

criteria.justification: Gallo-Roman villas positioned on slope with water access <200m. Rivers: Midour (source Hountan), Guillembounet, Mauran. Gués = points de friction classiques (pertes de monnaie, ferrures) — PLAN §7 rang B 'Carrefour ancien, gué, franchissement'. PLAN §2.1, PLAN §9.4 villa implantation.

criteria_reserved.label: Sky-View Factor — terrasses anciennes (LiDAR)

source.unlock_condition: T3.1 confirms LiDAR HD coverage of Gers + generates MNT 0.5m

criteria_reserved.justification: SVF detects artificial terraces / platforms from villa. Anomaly = neighboring H3 cells +20. [À VÉRIFIER] Gers LiDAR HD coverage (PLAN §10 risk 1).

criteria_reserved.label: Local Relief Model — enclos, fossés (LiDAR)
criteria_reserved.justification: LRM highlights enclosures and fortification ditches (mottes, hillforts). PLAN §3.2 relief visualization.

criteria_reserved.label: Openness — crêtes occupées (LiDAR)
criteria_reserved.justification: Openness detects ridges (hilltop occupation marker). Medieval fortifications preferred ridge positions.

criteria_reserved.label: Bâti disparu — différentiel Cassini/état-major/ortho

source.unlock_condition: T3.1 digitizes differential Cassini/état-major/1950-65 ortho/modern ortho

criteria_reserved.justification: Buildings present on Cassini/état-major but absent on modern ortho (farms, mills, chapels). PLAN §7 Rang A, CIBLES §0.

criteria_reserved.label: [MODULATEUR] Labour accessible (RPG)
criteria_reserved.justification: Labour (ploughed field) brings up soil artifacts. Optimal condition. PLAN §9.3, §9.9.

criteria_reserved.label: [MODULATEUR] Prairie permanente (RPG)
criteria_reserved.justification: Permanent grassland = undisturbed soil. Artifacts buried deeper, less detectable. PLAN §9.3.

criteria_reserved.label: [MODULATEUR] Bois (RPG + ortho)
criteria_reserved.justification: Forest: LiDAR excellent (micro-topo under vegetation), metal detection difficult (roots, tangled old iron). Reduce but don't block.

labour.notes: Multiplicative: applied AFTER base score calculation. If RPG unavailable in v1, fallback to ortho texture classification (not implemented).

bati.notes: Any H3 cell wholly overlapping built area (cadastral building footprint or ortho roof detection) = score 0 (inaccessible).

normalization.notes: Rough estimate: max weight sum ≈ 30+25+24+20+20+12+12 = 143 (no overlaps). With 1.3x labour multiplier → 186. Conservative ceiling 250 allows future criteria additions without rescale.

h3_parameters.notes: H3 res 10: hexagons ~65m across (vertex to vertex). Roughly matches cadastral parcel clustering in rural France. [À VÉRIFIER] local calibration against actual parcel sizes at Armous-et-Cau.

validation_rules.description: All ACTIVE criteria sources must be readable (file exists, GeoJSON valid, WMTS accessible).
No H3 cell receives the same criterion twice (e.g., Armous village not also counted as rank-1 microtoponyme).
Does scoring recover known archaeological sites from Patriarche WITHOUT them being input? Measure model quality.
validation_rules.notes: Results written to SCORING.md as evidence of model fidelity.

validation_rules.description: Full zone scoring completes in <3 seconds on typical machine.
